item.name: List Historical Webinar Sessions across Multiple Webinars / Hosts

request.name: List Historical Webinar Sessions across Multiple Webinars / Hosts

description.content:
Returns the list of historical Webinar Sessions hosted by particular user(s) or all company users
sorted by 'endTime' in the descending order. Depending on a session status 'endTime' can
represent actual end time or scheduled end time.
The user must have "WebinarSettings" permission granted otherwise the API returns HTTP 403.

query.description: Identifier of the user who hosts a webinar (if omitted, webinars hosted by all company users will be returned)
Filter to return only webinar sessions in certain status. Multiple values are supported.
Filter to return only webinar sessions in certain status. Multiple values are supported.
(Required) The beginning of the time window by 'endTime' .
(Required) The end of the time window by 'endTime' .

The number of items per page. If provided value in the request
is greater than a maximum, the maximum value is applied

The token indicating the particular page of the result set to be retrieved.
If omitted the first page will be returned.
